#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Helper: construct a project kickoff meeting ICS entry for next Monday 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time."""
import datetime as dt
import uuid
import sys


def next_monday() -> dt.date:
    """Return the date of the upcoming Monday (strictly after today)."""
    today = dt.date.today()
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0 in Python's weekday()
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + dt.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt_utc(d: dt.datetime) -> str:
    """Format a naive local datetime as UTC ICS timestamp (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ)."""
    return d.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def main() -> int:
    start_local = dt.datetime.combine(next_monday(), dt.time(10, 0))
    end_local = start_local + dt.timedelta(hours=2)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
        f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_local)}",
        f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_local)}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the new project. Runs 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time on "
        + next_monday().strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y")
        + ".",
        "LOCATION:TBD",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

    # Basic validation of the constructed entry
    assert end_local > start_local, "end must be after start"
    assert end_local - start_local == dt.timedelta(hours=2), "duration must be 2 hours"
    assert lines.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1 and lines.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
    assert lines.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") == 1 and lines.count("END:VCALENDAR") == 1
    assert "UID:" in content and "DTSTAMP:" in content

    sys.stdout.write(content)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
